checks.why: every hop names the LINE THE CALL IS WRITTEN ON, not only the callee's declaration: that is the line a reader checks the hop at, and the chain used to carry neither it nor the kind (#1107)
the hop count counts CALLS. A containment hop (a closure written inside a body) is marked and excluded, because 'A reaches B in N calls' is false when some of the N are not calls
a construction is not an invocation and must not print as one: the kind comes from call_edges.kind, which the exporter used to drop
the tiers an answer used are legended under it, so no reader has to look up what one means
--json carries every hop with its tier, kind and call site, and stdout alone is one document
